import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_LIMIT = 1000000;
    static final long MOD_CONST1 = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD_CONST2 = 1000000007L;

    static long total_num, max_num, counter_var;
    static int answer_val, digit_count_arr[] = new int[7];
    static int[][][] sum_data = new int[7][7][MAX_LIMIT + 1];
    static int[][] count_arrs = new int[7][7];

    static void setup(int x, int depth, int max_depth) {
        sum_data[max_depth][depth][++count_arrs[max_depth][depth]] = (int)((++counter_var) - x);
        if (depth == max_depth) return;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            setup(x * 10 + i, depth + 1, max_depth);
        }
    }

    static void brute_force(long x, int depth) {
        if (x > total_num) return;
        ++counter_var;
        answer_val = (int)((answer_val + (counter_var - x) / MOD_CONST1 - (counter_var < x ? 1 : 0) + MOD_CONST2) % MOD_CONST2);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            brute_force(x * 10 + i, depth + 1);
        }
    }

    static void process_num(int x, int depth) {
        if (depth != 6) {
            ++counter_var;
            answer_val = (int)((answer_val + (counter_var - x) / MOD_CONST1 - (counter_var < x ? 1 : 0) + MOD_CONST2) % MOD_CONST2);
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                process_num(x * 10 + i, depth + 1);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (x == max_num) {
            brute_force(x, 0);
            return;
        }
        int k = 0;
        long v = x;
        while (k <= 6 && v <= total_num) {
            v *= 10;
            k++;
        }
        k--;
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            v = counter_var - 1L * x * digit_count_arr[i];
            long v_div = v / MOD_CONST1;
            long v_mod = ((v % MOD_CONST1) + MOD_CONST1) % MOD_CONST1;
            answer_val = (int)((answer_val + v_div - (v < 0 ? 1 : 0) + MOD_CONST2) % MOD_CONST2);
            answer_val = (int)((answer_val + digit_count_arr[i] - (lowerBound(sum_data[k][i], sum_data[k][i] + digit_count_arr[i], (int)v_mod) - sum_data[k][i]) + 1) % MOD_CONST2);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
            counter_var += digit_count_arr[i];
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(int[] arr, int[] arr_end, int target) {
        int low = 0;
        int high = arr_end - arr;
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        total_num = sc.nextLong();
        digit_count_arr[0] = 1;
        for (int k = 1; k <= 6; k++) {
            digit_count_arr[k] = digit_count_arr[k - 1] * 10;
        }
        for (int k = 0; k <= 6; k++) {
            counter_var = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                count_arrs[k][i] = 0;
            }
            setup(0, 0, k);
            for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
                Arrays.sort(sum_data[k][i], 0, count_arrs[k][i] + 1);
            }
        }
        counter_var = 0;
        if (counter_var == 0 && total_num < 1e6) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
                brute_force(i, 1);
            }
        } else {
            max_num = total_num;
            while (max_num >= 1e6) max_num /= 10;
            for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
                process_num(i, 1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println((int)((1L * (MOD_CONST2 - answer_val) * MOD_CONST1) % MOD_CONST2));
        sc.close();
    }
}
